sections.voiceover: On January 29, 2025, an American Airlines regional jet and a U.S. Army Black Hawk helicopter collided near Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport. How did this fatal intersection happen?
sections.visual_cue: Animated flight paths showing the intersection of the helicopter route and the runway approach.
sections.sfx_cue: Radar ping sounds and rhythmic, low-frequency hum.

sections.voiceover: The U.S. Army investigation revealed that the Federal Aviation Administration placed Helicopter Route 4 dangerously.
sections.visual_cue: Close up of the U.S. Army investigation report cover page.

sections.voiceover: The October 8, 2026, report confirmed these structural hazards directly caused the midair collision. Investigators blamed the Federal Aviation Administration for positioning that route too close to the runway 33 approach.
